Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $90 in August?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (3% odds) on crude reach $90. Closes in 5d. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.
